title: Wix App Maintenance
meta: A fixed starter sprint of updates, bug fixes and a health report to keep your Wix app running. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Keep your Wix app running with a care sprint
overview: Wix changes its SDK, dashboard components and editor often, and older apps can drift out of date. In this one-time sprint we update your dependencies and SDK versions, fix open bugs, test install, update and uninstall on a development site, check billing and data flows and give you a short health report. Ongoing monthly care is quoted separately.

faq: No. This is a fixed starter sprint with a clear start and end. If you want regular care afterwards, we quote a monthly plan separately, based on what the health report finds.
What if Wix retires a feature my app uses?
We check for upcoming removals in the Wix developer notes, list the ones that affect you and fix the urgent ones inside your package. Larger rewrites are quoted as a separate migration.
Can you fix an app that stopped working?
Usually yes. Send us the error and a description of when it began, and we confirm the fit before you order. Many failures come from one changed API or component.
Do you need Dev Center access?
Yes, as a collaborator with limited roles, plus repository access. We never ask for your passwords, and you can remove our access when the sprint is over.
